map.车厢 4.2×1.8×1.8 m = 13.608 m³，单箱 0.4×0.3×: Cargo box 4.2×1.8×1.8 m = 13.608 m³, single box 0.4×0.3×0.3 = 0.036 m³. Theoretical box count = 13.608 ÷ 0.036 = 378; allowing 0.75 for stacking gaps → 283 boxes. With a payload limit of 5 t and 5 kg per box, weight would allow 1 000 boxes, so volume is the limit: 283 boxes actually loaded (1 415 kg). Volume utilization 74.9%, weight utilization 28.3% — there is plenty of payload headroom left, so switch to lighter packaging or a smaller truck.
map.实际装车存在码放间隙、异形货物与装卸通道占用，理论箱数一般打七五折。工具已内置该: Real loading involves stacking gaps, irregular goods and loading aisles, so the theoretical box count is usually discounted by about a quarter. The tool has this factor built in; if your goods are regular and stack tightly you may estimate upward from the theoretical value.
map.「受限因素」显示体积或重量怎么用？: How do I use the "limiting factor" showing volume or weight?
map.显示体积说明还有载重余量，可加高码放或换更大车厢；显示重量说明车厢没装满但已接近: Volume means there is payload headroom left, so you can stack higher or use a larger cargo box; weight means the box is not full but is near the weight limit, so switch to a higher-payload vehicle or reduce the weight per box.

map.单箱体积 = (箱长/100) × (箱宽/100) × (箱高/100)（m³: Single carton volume = (carton length/100) × (carton width/100) × (carton height/100) (m³)
map.体积理论箱数 = ⌊车厢体积 ÷ 单箱体积⌋: Theoretical cartons by volume = ⌊cargo volume ÷ single carton volume⌋
map.体积实际箱数 = ⌊体积理论箱数 × 0.75⌋（计 25% 空间损耗）: Actual cartons by volume = ⌊theoretical cartons by volume × 0.75⌋ (allowing 25% space loss)
map.重量限制箱数 = ⌊载重(kg) ÷ 单箱重量⌋: Cartons limited by weight = ⌊payload (kg) ÷ single carton weight⌋
map.实际可装 = min(体积实际箱数, 重量限制箱数): Actually loadable = min(actual cartons by volume, cartons limited by weight)
map.总重量 = 实际箱数 × 单箱重量；占用体积 = 实际箱数 × 单箱体积: Total weight = actual cartons × single carton weight; occupied volume = actual cartons × single carton volume
map.体积利用率 = 占用体积 ÷ 车厢体积 × 100%: Volume utilization = occupied volume ÷ cargo volume × 100%
map.限制因素 = 体积实际箱数 < 重量限制箱数 时取体积，否则重量: Limiting factor = volume when actual cartons by volume < cartons limited by weight, otherwise weight
map.利用率 <70% 提示调整包装尺寸；输入箱尺寸格式 L×W×H: Utilization < 70% prompts adjusting the package size; carton size format is L×W×H
